newsitem.title: UK: Disney launches London's most expensive musical.
newsitem.headline: Disney launches London's most expensive musical.

text.p: Walt Disney is to stage the most expensive show ever mounted in London's theatreland with "Beauty and the Beast" already taking more than five million pounds ($8.1 million) in advance bookings.
A company spokesman said on Monday that the musical cost 10 million pounds to stage with its cast of 40 and 25-strong orchestra.
The show, with lyrics by Oscar-winning writer Tim Rice, has already run for three years on Broadway in New York and been staged in Tokyo, Vienna, Toronto and Sydney.
This is Disney's first foray into London's West End, already dominated by Andrew Lloyd Webber musicals.
The Dominion Theatre, where the show opens on Tuesday, has been specially extended to make room for the wardrobe department's 230 costumes.
